source_evidence: All investments have some degree of risk. Markets fluctuate over time, and individual investments may lose value.
answer: Investment risk is the possibility that an investment may lose value. Risk does not disappear over time: markets fluctuate, and individual investments can fall in value. When thinking about risk, consider your time horizon—how long before you need the money—and your personal tolerance for risk. These factors can help you choose investment products that fit your situation. Asset allocation and diversification are strategies that can help manage risk, though they do not eliminate it.
